description: Stable business-data interface owned by SupportOps for approved external analytical consumers. It defines business semantics, not persistence or ORM structure.

data_classifications.public: Approved for unrestricted disclosure. No v1 field is classified public by default.
data_classifications.internal: Operational business data for approved internal consumers; not for unrestricted disclosure.
data_classifications.confidential: Identifiers or business facts that can identify, correlate, or profile a tenant, customer, conversation, actor, order, ticket, or action. Approved consumers must enforce tenant-scoped access.
data_classifications.restricted: Free text, opaque JSON, detailed audit data, prompts, model responses, secrets, traces, or infrastructure metadata. Restricted data is outside this contract.

new_major_required_for: Change dataset grain or primary-key semantics.
Change an optional field to required.
Change the meaning of an enum value.

datasets.name: orders_v1
datasets.description: SupportOps operational order facts, one current row per order within its tenant.
datasets.grain: One row represents one order in one tenant at the time the dataset is produced.

primary_key.semantic_meaning: The tenant and order identifier together are the stable logical identity. This is a business key, not a statement about ORM primary-key implementation.

stability.compatibility: Subject to the contract-level v1.x compatibility rules.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Identifier of the tenant that owns the order.
fields.semantic_meaning: Required partition and authorization scope for every order fact.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable within SupportOps; consumers must not join or disclose across tenants.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: SupportOps business identifier for the order.
fields.semantic_meaning: Uniquely identifies an order within tenant_id.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable SupportOps correlation key within a tenant; it is not public data.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Identifier of the customer associated with the order.
fields.semantic_meaning: Identifies the customer relationship for tenant-scoped analysis.
fields.identifier_semantics: Pseudonymous identifier; it is not public data.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current operational order lifecycle status.
fields.semantic_meaning: Producer-defined current order status. V1 does not declare a closed enum because the current source does not enforce one.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Original order monetary amount used by SupportOps.
fields.semantic_meaning: A monetary amount in major currency units; it is not a binary floating-point contract value.
fields.serialization: Canonical base-10 decimal string; no exponent notation.
fields.currency_semantics: The current source does not provide a currency code. A delivery must declare one known currency context for its partition, and consumers must not aggregate or convert values across unknown or different currencies.

fields.name: refundable_amount
fields.description: Amount currently available to quote for a refund for the order.
fields.semantic_meaning: Current refund-eligible monetary amount, not a settled refund total.
fields.serialization: Canonical base-10 decimal string; no exponent notation.
fields.currency_semantics: Uses the same declared currency context as amount; no cross-currency inference or conversion is permitted.

fields.name: refund_status
fields.description: Current SupportOps refund-request status for the order.
fields.semantic_meaning: Local operational refund state only; it does not prove payment-provider processing, reconciliation, or settlement.

fields.name: return_status
fields.description: Current SupportOps return-request status for the order.
fields.semantic_meaning: Local operational return state only; it does not prove physical receipt, inspection, or completion of a return.

datasets.name: tickets_v1
datasets.description: SupportOps support-ticket facts, one current row per ticket within its tenant.
datasets.grain: One row represents one support ticket in one tenant at the time the dataset is produced.

primary_key.semantic_meaning: The tenant and ticket identifier together are the stable logical identity.

stability.compatibility: Subject to the contract-level v1.x compatibility rules.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Identifier of the tenant that owns the ticket.
fields.semantic_meaning: Required partition and authorization scope for every ticket fact.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable within SupportOps; consumers must not join or disclose across tenants.

fields.name: ticket_id
fields.description: SupportOps business identifier for the support ticket.
fields.semantic_meaning: Uniquely identifies a ticket within tenant_id.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable SupportOps correlation key within a tenant; it is not public data.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Identifier of the customer for whom the ticket was created.
fields.semantic_meaning: Customer relationship for tenant-scoped support analysis.
fields.identifier_semantics: Pseudonymous identifier; it is not public data.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.description: Identifier correlating the ticket to its support conversation.
fields.semantic_meaning: Correlation key for a conversation, not the conversation's text content.
fields.identifier_semantics: Pseudonymous identifier; it is not public data.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current support-ticket lifecycle status.
fields.semantic_meaning: Current state of the SupportOps ticket lifecycle.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Current operational priority assigned to the ticket.
fields.semantic_meaning: SupportOps triage priority, not a customer-facing service guarantee.

fields.name: assignee_id
fields.description: Identifier of the currently assigned support agent, when one exists.
fields.semantic_meaning: Current ticket ownership assignment; null means no agent is assigned.
fields.identifier_semantics: SupportOps actor identifier; it is not public personnel data.

fields.name: sla_due_at
fields.description: Time by which the ticket is due under the current SupportOps SLA calculation.
fields.semantic_meaning: Operational due time, not a statement that an SLA was met or breached.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC instant serialized in RFC 3339 format with an explicit offset.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Time at which SupportOps created the ticket.
fields.semantic_meaning: Ticket creation instant.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC instant serialized in RFC 3339 format with an explicit offset.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Time at which SupportOps last updated the ticket record.
fields.semantic_meaning: Latest persisted ticket-record update instant; it is not necessarily a customer-message time.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC instant serialized in RFC 3339 format with an explicit offset.

datasets.name: ticket_events_v1
datasets.grain: One row represents one recorded transition of one ticket from one status to another in one tenant.

primary_key.semantic_meaning: The tenant and event identifier together are the stable logical identity.

relationships.semantic_meaning: Each transition belongs to exactly one ticket in the same tenant.

stability.compatibility: Subject to the contract-level v1.x compatibility rules.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Identifier of the tenant that owns the ticket event.
fields.semantic_meaning: Required partition and authorization scope for every ticket event.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable within SupportOps; consumers must not join or disclose across tenants.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: SupportOps business identifier for the recorded transition event.
fields.semantic_meaning: Uniquely identifies one ticket transition within tenant_id.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable SupportOps correlation key within a tenant; it is not public data.

fields.name: ticket_id
fields.description: Identifier of the ticket whose status changed.
fields.semantic_meaning: References tickets_v1 within the same tenant.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable SupportOps correlation key within a tenant; it is not public data.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: Identifier of the principal that performed the recorded transition.
fields.semantic_meaning: Actor attribution for operational analysis; no actor profile is exposed.
fields.identifier_semantics: SupportOps principal identifier; it is not public data.

fields.name: from_status
fields.description: Ticket status immediately before the recorded transition.
fields.semantic_meaning: Prior state in the SupportOps ticket lifecycle.

fields.name: to_status
fields.description: Ticket status immediately after the recorded transition.
fields.semantic_meaning: Resulting state in the SupportOps ticket lifecycle.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Time at which SupportOps recorded the transition.
fields.semantic_meaning: Recorded transition instant, not free-text note time.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC instant serialized in RFC 3339 format with an explicit offset.

datasets.name: actions_v1
datasets.description: Durable SupportOps refund or return-request lifecycle facts.
datasets.grain: One row represents one logical customer-requested refund or return operation in one tenant, at its current persisted lifecycle state.

primary_key.semantic_meaning: The tenant and action identifier together are the stable logical identity for a requested business action.

relationships.semantic_meaning: When present, the action concerns this order in the same tenant. Null is retained for migrated legacy records without a verified order reference.
When present, the ticket is the SupportOps human-review ticket associated with the action.

stability.compatibility: Subject to the contract-level v1.x compatibility rules.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Identifier of the tenant that owns the requested business action.
fields.semantic_meaning: Required partition and authorization scope for every action fact.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable within SupportOps; consumers must not join or disclose across tenants.

fields.name: action_id
fields.description: SupportOps business identifier for the requested refund or return operation.
fields.semantic_meaning: Uniquely identifies one durable requested business action within tenant_id.
fields.identifier_semantics: Stable action correlation key within a tenant; it is not a receipt payload.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Identifier of the order targeted by the action, when verified.
fields.semantic_meaning: References orders_v1 within the same tenant. New actions are order-scoped; null preserves the known limitation of migrated legacy records.
fields.identifier_semantics: Order correlation key within a tenant.

fields.name: ticket_id
fields.description: Identifier of the human-review ticket associated with the action, when one exists.
fields.semantic_meaning: References tickets_v1 within the same tenant; null means no associated human-review ticket.
fields.identifier_semantics: Ticket correlation key within a tenant.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.description: Identifier of the support conversation in which the action was requested.
fields.semantic_meaning: Conversation correlation key only; no conversation content is exposed.
fields.identifier_semantics: Pseudonymous identifier; it is not public data.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Identifier of the customer who requested the action.
fields.semantic_meaning: Customer relationship for tenant-scoped action analysis.
fields.identifier_semantics: Pseudonymous identifier; it is not public data.

fields.name: action_kind
fields.description: Business operation requested by the customer.
fields.semantic_meaning: Determines whether the durable action is a refund request or a return request.

fields.name: action_status
fields.description: Current durable lifecycle status of the requested business action.
fields.semantic_meaning: Local SupportOps lifecycle state. submitted records a local submission; it does not prove provider processing, settlement, physical return completion, or reconciliation.

fields.name: quoted_amount
fields.description: Refund amount quoted when the refund action was prepared.
fields.semantic_meaning: Present only for refund actions. It is a local quoted amount, not proof of payment processing or settlement.
fields.serialization: Canonical base-10 decimal string; no exponent notation.
fields.currency_semantics: Uses the delivery's declared currency context. Null is required for return_request actions; consumers must not infer a value from omitted internal data.

fields.name: approval_required
fields.description: Whether SupportOps policy requires a human approval before the action can progress.
fields.semantic_meaning: Current policy requirement for the action; it does not reveal an approver identity or approval evidence.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Time at which SupportOps created the durable action.
fields.semantic_meaning: Action creation instant.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC instant serialized in RFC 3339 format with an explicit offset.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: Time after which an uncompleted action proposal expires.
fields.semantic_meaning: Confirmation or approval expiry instant; it does not itself state that an action is terminal.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC instant serialized in RFC 3339 format with an explicit offset.

fields.name: confirmed_at
fields.description: Time at which SupportOps recorded the required customer confirmation, when one was recorded.
fields.semantic_meaning: Records confirmation timing without exposing the confirming actor or confirmation payload.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC instant serialized in RFC 3339 format with an explicit offset.

fields.name: terminal_at
fields.description: Time at which SupportOps recorded a terminal lifecycle outcome, when one exists.
fields.semantic_meaning: Terminal action lifecycle instant; it is not payment settlement or physical-return completion time.
fields.timestamp_semantics: UTC instant serialized in RFC 3339 format with an explicit offset.
